details: Examples 1-15: PPG2000/PPG4000 1:1, polyester, acrylic polymer, CaCO3 and MDI. Dehydrate all except MDI under vacuum at 110-130 C for 60 min; add 4,4-MDI; react 130 C for 75 min. Viscosity Brookfield DV-I+ #27 at 121 C. Open time endpoint is loss of transfer from 0.8 g adhesive dispensed at 121 C to a wooden tongue depressor during cooling to 23 C. Green strength uses hardwood cross-peeler specimens and is tracked at 5-30 min.

Polyol at 80 C under nitrogen for 0.5 h; benzoyl peroxide 2-3 drops then 5 min mixing; MDI added in one portion with exotherm held <=90 C; after cooling to about 75 C, heat to 115 C for 1 h. Free NCO measured by ASTM D-1638-74 titration. Add 1.0 wt% 3-aminopropyltriethoxysilane and 500 ppm DBTDL. Adhesive equilibrated at 120 C for bonding. Lap shear on PE, Al, PC and PVC after 1, 24 and 168 h cure at 25 C/50% RH, ASTM D1002, 12 in/min, n=3.

Semi-crystalline polyester polyols are disclosed with Tc ranges including -20 to 35 C, measured by DSC during a heating or cooling cycle at 10 C/min. This is not an example-specific measured value and must not be joined to individual Example 1-8 rows as ground truth.
